title: MITRE CAR Schema v1.0
description: JSON Schema definitions for MITRE Cyber Analytics Repository (CAR) standard. CAR provides cyber analytics and data models for detection of ATT&CK techniques.

analytic.title: CAR Analytic
analytic.description: Detection analytic from MITRE CAR (Cyber Analytics Repository) indexed by CAR-YYYY-MM-NNN identifier.

id.description: Unique CAR identifier in format CAR-YYYY-MM-NNN (e.g., CAR-2013-01-002)

information_domain.description: Primary information domain covered by this analytic

platforms.description: Target platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS, etc.; or 'N/A' if not applicable)

analytic_types.description: Analytic type classification (Situational Awareness, Detection, etc.)

contributors.description: Contributors who developed or maintained this analytic

description.description: Detailed description of the analytic, its purpose, and methodology

tactics.description: ATT&CK tactics associated with this technique (e.g., TA0009, TA0008)

coverage.description: Level of coverage for this technique
ATT&CK technique coverage array - minimum 1 required

code.description: Code or pseudocode for the analytic implementation

implementations.description: Optional implementations of the detection analytic

data_model_references.description: References to CAR data model fields used by this analytic (e.g., flow/message/dest_port)

iri.description: IRI reference to D3FEND defensive technique

label.description: Display label for the D3FEND mapping

d3fend_mappings.description: Optional mappings to D3FEND defensive techniques

datamodel.title: CAR Data Model Entity
datamodel.description: Data model entity definition from MITRE CAR representing a cyber observable (Process, File, Flow, etc.)

name.description: Name of the data model entity (e.g., Process, File, Flow, Registry)

description.description: Detailed description of this data model entity and its semantics

name.description: Action name (e.g., create, terminate, access, load)

description.description: Description of when/how this action occurs

actions.description: Actions that can be performed on this entity

name.description: Field name (e.g., fqdn, pid, command_line, image_path)

description.description: Detailed description of the field and its semantics

fields.description: Fields/attributes available for this data model entity

sensor.title: CAR Sensor Definition
sensor.description: Sensor capability definition showing how a data source maps to CAR data model entities and actions

sensor_name.description: Name of the data source/sensor (e.g., Sysmon, osquery, auditd)

sensor_description.description: Description of the sensor and its purpose

object.description: CAR data model object being mapped (e.g., file, driver, flow, process)

action.description: Action on the object (e.g., create, load, start, send)

notes.description: Implementation notes for this mapping (e.g., Event ID reference)

fields.description: CAR data model fields populated by this sensor event

mappings.description: Mappings from sensor events to CAR data model entities and actions
